recognize_zh: Kappa 免疫染色中，大片腫瘤細胞群幾乎全為藍色核、不著色，僅一兩個細胞弱陽性；周圍蛋白質性積液強烈背景著色。腫瘤不表現 kappa，與 lambda 同樣陰性，符合 PEL 缺乏免疫球蛋白。
features: Large aggregate of round intermediate-to-large tumor cells in effusion cell block
Tumor cells negative for kappa, with only rare isolated positive cell (likely reactive plasma cell)
Strong background staining of surrounding proteinaceous fluid (serum immunoglobulin)
Faint cytoplasmic blush attributable to background diffusion rather than true expression
describe_en: Kappa light chain immunohistochemistry on an effusion cell block shows a large aggregate of neoplastic cells that are negative, with only a rare isolated positive cell and intense background staining of the proteinaceous fluid. Combined with the negative lambda stain, the tumor lacks detectable immunoglobulin light chain expression. Light-chain negativity in a CD20-negative, MUM1-positive, HHV8-positive large-cell effusion lymphoma is consistent with primary effusion lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Myeloma shows strong monotypic cytoplasmic light chain, whereas these cells are negative for both kappa and lambda.
HHV8+ DLBCL usually expresses IgM lambda, whereas this tumor is light-chain negative.
Carcinoma is also Ig-negative but is keratin-positive and CD45/MUM1/LANA-negative.
